rows.details: District Agriculture Office, Simdega (Agriculture, Animal Husbandry and Co-operative Department, Government of Jharkhand)
Rs. 11,851/- per month (Fixed consolidated pay / Daily wage basis)
Matric (10th) pass with minimum 05 days training

content_sections.heading: Where and How to Send
content_sections.text: Applicants must submit their fully filled application form along with self-attested photocopies of required certificates either by hand during office hours (10:00 AM to 05:00 PM) or through registered / speed post to the following address: Sub-Divisional-cum-District Agriculture Officer, Simdega, Joint District Agriculture Office Complex, (Near Sadar Hospital, Simdega), Post - Simdega, District - Simdega, Pin - 835223

content_sections.heading: Posts, Eligibility and Pay
content_sections.text: Passing of Matric / Secondary (10th) examination from a recognized educational institution. Mandatory receipt of a minimum 05 (five) days training from the Department of Agriculture and Cane Development under the Department of Agriculture, Animal Husbandry and Co-operative, Government of Jharkhand, Ranchi (or Directorate of Agriculture and Horticulture). Must have knowledge of the local language. Proficiency in riding a bicycle and climbing trees. Must be a local resident of Simdega district. Minimum age is 18 years, and the maximum age limit is as determined by the State Government for various categories from time to time, calculated as of 01.01.2026. content_sections.heading: District Agriculture Office, Simdega Crop Guard (Kamdar) Vacancy Details (Category-wise)
content_sections.text: The total of 7 vacancies for the Crop Guard (Kamdar) post are distributed across plant protection centres in Simdega district as follows: Plant Protection Centre, Simdega (Sadar) Plant Protection Centre, Kurdeg Plant Protection Centre, Bolba Plant Protection Centre, Thethaitangar Plant Protection Centre, Jaldega Plant Protection Centre, Kolebira Plant Protection Centre, Bano Category-wise breakdown of the total 7 vacancies:

content_sections.heading: District Agriculture Office, Simdega Crop Guard (Kamdar) Job Description
content_sections.text: The duties assigned to the Crop Guard include: Crop surveillance Spraying of pesticides Farmer training and awareness Other tasks assigned by the office from time to time

content_sections.heading: Enclosures
content_sections.text: Applicants must attach self-attested photocopies of the following documents with their application: Matric / 10th passing certificate, marksheet, and mark sheet showing Hindi marks if applicable Minimum 05 (five) days training certificate Training certificate for more than 05 days duration (if applicable) Valid local residential certificate issued by a competent authority Valid caste certificate issued by a competent authority, where applicable Proof of date of birth (Matric / 10th certificate) Aadhaar card photocopy

content_sections.heading: Selection Process
content_sections.text: The selection process consists of scrutiny of applications and an evaluation out of 100 total marks structured as follows: Educational Qualification: Marks obtained in Matric marksheet multiplied by 0.6 (maximum 60 marks). Training: Minimum 01 five-day training = 08 marks; training exceeding 5 days = 12 marks (only one training certificate will be valid). Skill Test: Bicycle riding and climbing trees capability test (Qualifying). Interview: General Hindi, General Knowledge, and Local Language Knowledge (20 marks). Tie-breaking criteria prioritize higher marks in Matric, higher age, and alphabetical order of names.

content_sections.heading: Important Instructions
content_sections.text: The appointment is purely on a contract/daily wage remuneration basis for one year or until regular appointment. Incomplete applications or applications without self-attested photocopies of required certificates will be rejected. Character/conduct certificates are not required with the application but must be submitted during document verification or joining. Candidates must submit valid certificates issued by competent authorities in prescribed formats. The number of vacancies may be modified as per administrative needs.

faq.question: Q1. How many vacancies are announced for Crop Guard in Simdega?
faq.answer: A total of 7 vacancies have been announced for the Crop Guard (Kamdar) post under the District Agriculture Office, Simdega.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to submit the application form?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the filled application form by hand or through registered/speed post is 26 October 2026 up to 05:00 PM.

faq.question: Q3. What is the required educational qualification?
faq.answer: Candidates must have passed Matric / Secondary (10th) from a recognized institution and possess a minimum 05-day training certificate from the Department of Agriculture.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The minimum age is 18 years, and the maximum age limit is as determined by the State Government for various categories as of 01.01.2026.

faq.question: Q5. What is the monthly pay for the Crop Guard post?
faq.answer: Selected candidates will receive a monthly consolidated pay / daily wage remuneration of Rs. 11,851/-.

faq.question: Q6. Is there any application fee?
faq.answer: The notification does not mention any application fee.

faq.question: Q7. How can I apply for this vacancy?
faq.answer: Candidates must apply offline by downloading the application format from the notification, filling it completely, attaching self-attested document copies, and sending or submitting it to the Subdivisional-cum-District Agriculture Officer, Simdega.

faq.question: Q8. What is the selection process?
faq.answer: Selection is based on application scrutiny, evaluation out of 100 marks (including Matric marks, training duration, interview), and a qualifying practical skill test for bicycle riding and tree climbing.

faq.question: Q9. Is this job permanent or on contract?
faq.answer: The appointment is purely on a contract basis for one year or until regular appointment is made, whichever is earlier.

faq.question: Q10. Which documents must be attached with the application?
faq.answer: Applicants must attach self-attested copies of their 10th marksheet and certificate, 5-day training certificate, local residential certificate, caste certificate, date of birth proof, and Aadhaar card.
